introduction:
Hi, I’m Soily! You’re exploring Croptato’s test account as John, our demonstration farmer in Kherson Oblast, Ukraine. His example field is about 30 hectares and relies on rainfall. The illustrative crop history is sunflower, sunflower, then wheat; exact years and field-specific soil tests are still missing.

You can explore saved example dashboards and data without signing in. These are demonstration scenarios, not validated farm recommendations. Ask me about the data, what’s missing, why the examples differ, or what might change if John irrigated, changed crops, or chose a different priority. I can explain and discuss changes; the saved examples stay available for everyone.

strategies.title: Economic Potential
strategies.description: Illustrative scenario with a crop in every planning year. Profit is unavailable because local yields, prices and costs have not been supplied.

strategies.title: Balanced
strategies.description: Illustrative scenario combining crop diversity with one mulch-fallow year. Fallow has no saleable harvest.

strategies.title: Climate & Soil Resilience
strategies.description: Illustrative scenario emphasizing cool-season crops and residue-oriented management. Soil and moisture outcomes have not been calculated.

limitations: The field geometry and profile are synthetic demonstration assumptions, not verified cadastral or farmer measurements.
These are eight planning years, not dated crop records. Sowing and harvest windows, disease-return intervals, predecessors, and year 8 → year 1 continuity still require validation.
Historical climate analysis is planned for NASA POWER 2016–2025. No NASA data is connected or calculated in this test workspace.
Profit, yield, crop scores and soil-loss estimates are unavailable. Missing analysis is not zero.
